steps.title: Live work detail
steps.evidence: Live work detail: 19/19 browser assertions against a real S6 run, page never reloaded. Found and fixed the root cause — sseBroadcast was in-process, so every live update the runner ever sent went into an empty client set. Now bridged over Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY.

steps.title: Repair the degraded console
steps.evidence: All four Done-when clauses observed. 170 assertions: audit 115 across 16 routes (overflow, accessible names, touch targets, colour-alone, AA contrast, reduced motion, focus at every keyboard stop, build-bar patterns for all 5 states), states 19 (each forced: empty, offline and permission-denied on ALL 15 routes, stale after a real minute offline, counts read from the database not the page's array), journeys 36 (six on a 375px phone and again keyboard-only, each ending in a DB check) + PWA installable.

steps.title: The credential loop
steps.evidence: N4 end to end from a phone with no session: 26 assertions, every effect checked in the database. A dead credential parks three tasks, produces ONE ticket and ONE link; the wrong key is refused with the provider's own words while the ticket stays open; the right key stores project-scoped, tests healthy, closes the ticket and requeues all three by itself. Replayed link 409, expired link 409 and stores nothing.

steps.title: Artifacts and output control
steps.evidence: 75 assertions: 57 API + 18 browser. All twelve types render; provenance recorded AT registration; the full state path plus both exits; a rejection with a note creates a queued task against the same project; v2 supersedes v1 with both surviving and a line-level compare; superseding at the same path is REFUSED because the old bytes would be gone; quarantined artifacts cannot be downloaded at all; fifty artifacts paginate; a run with no output says so.

steps.title: Global search, the command palette, and the activity feed
steps.evidence: 52 assertions: 37 API + 15 browser. Search across ten sources grouped by kind, including inside dumped documents via knowledge_chunks. The isolation clause proved as an isolation test: project B's marker planted in EVERY searchable source, invisible to a search scoped to A, while A's own content is found. Activity feed per project with pagination and an empty state; resource_metrics with a real least-squares slope. Palette commands hit the same endpoints as the pages, asserted in the database, and open with a tap on a phone.

steps.title: Close the containment gaps

steps.title: The retrofit sweep
steps.evidence: All five retrofit items, 66 assertions. Checkpoints record WHY and the resume path reads them. The three taxonomy-only error classes exist, with a real liveness-vs-progress detector for agent.repeat. Internal posts dedupe atomically. The recovery ladder climbs ten rungs cheapest-first, records each including the two that are not available yet, respects every limit and ends at Enrique. The status bar has all six states, forced individually. The composer's inbox row is byte-shape-identical to WhatsApp's.
